description: Andrew-direct 2026-08-24 ~16:0xZ at the base CTO terminal, the FIRST of three findings from the 49 Financial meeting (Mike) -- the first of 'two separate projects that split out' of the ADVI project for 49; recorded VERBATIM in full at org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/ANDREW_DIRECT_20260824_49F_ADVI_STRUCTURE_0833_INGESTION_FIDELITY_INSURANCE_SPLIT.md (@dbf4e493eb). His words that bind this project: 'these can be pulled as current value snapshot from Black Diamond's insurance endpoint. The project there is going to be figuring out how this integrates backend and frontend. Backend I think we create a bucket somewhere in opal-data-assets for black diamond with an insurance subfolder or something like that which is subfoldered again to 49. This creates the pattern for how we structure insurance NAVs per account on Black Diamond (which will be good to have because this will have to be done later for Cottonwood as well ...). That covers bronze/silver ingestion, the gold transformation will be very, very light, we don't do any analytics on this we basically just transform as necessary through an additive script that will keep some kind of current state rows in a gold subfolder with in-pattern structured parquets in opal-data-49financial ... This goes into some platinum json output which will be readable by the portal.' Frontend: 'We can't blend this in to any asset management calculations because the format is too different ... a category error and cannot happen.' (1) header PartnerAnalytics.Tsx -- insurance segment total NAV added onto the AM AUM in the panel subtext; (2) account level -- a separate insurance view, maybe its own radial segment "Insurance" (NOT folding into "Alternatives"); (3) aggregates account -> client/relationship -> advisor -> Firm in the Books or related tab views ONLY -- 'avoid [the Advisor or Distribution tabs] categorically'; lives in the Books drilldown + the Advisor's Book view on advisorpublicprofile. PROGRAM FRAME (finding 3, @1cda24912a): a PRECONDITION of per-client performance attribution + reporting (ADVI_PERFRP) -- you cannot attribute performance while insurance is blended into AM calcs. BUILD LADDER RUNG 2 (measured 2026-08-24 ~17:2xZ): DATA_BDINSURANCE (Andrew-named, 2026-08-20, Cottonwood, Phase 0) already RESOLVED the SOURCE SURFACE by HAR-2 -- BD ships a purpose-built insurance application (/insurance/): POST /request/api/offline/insurancerelationshiplist = ASYNC BULK EXPORT ({exportResultID, resultGuid}, the run-then-fetch pattern the DataMining ETL already operates) and POST /account-api/query/accountdetailsearch = per-account detail incl. insuranceCharacteristics + insuranceCharacteristicsRiders + currentEmv; auth = the /session/token bearer, a separate authority. REUSE that surface and its ingest-heavy pattern; its open sovereign call (HEAVY vs LIGHT -- 'depends on how much advisors care about insurance assets') is ANSWERED for 49F by this finding: HEAVY (own segment, own account-level view, aggregation up the spine; NEVER the alternatives fold-in that PRD chose for Cottonwood). Its own line 88: 'a 49F insurance surface, if wanted, is its own project on its own tree' -- this is that project; bd<->cot separation is absolute (gate + IAM). GRAMMAR NOTE (CTO recommendation, the decomp fixes it inside his words): his phrasing puts 'insurance' between vendor and firm; the canonical grammar is {vendor}/{firm}/{medallion} (Rule 17b / Rule 24 one-grain-per-axis), so the in-pattern candidate is opal-data-assets/blackdiamond/49financial/{bronze,silver}/insurance_* (table-level), joining the blackdiamond/49f/silver/* join dims already there; raw API bytes land as bronze (Rule 17a), parquet is a silver act; gold = additive current-state rows in opal-data-49financial/gold/advi/ (the 08-19 mint, his 'prior art' -- confirmed); platinum under platinum/advi/49financial/. FRONTEND PRIOR ART: portal/src/pages/AdvisorIntelligence/_shared/components/PartnerAnalytics.tsx (header), _shared/AdvisorPublicProfile.tsx + _shared/AdvisorBookView.tsx (Books / Book view), _shared/lib/composition.ts CANONICAL_CLASSES = ['equity','fixed_income','alternatives'] (+cash) and the per-partner layout.ts ordered lists -- 'Insurance' is a NEW VALUE on that category axis: a Rule-24 enumeration act with its four-postulate record owed at decomp (D1's ruled taxonomy already carries Insurance as a top-level view, consistent).
